answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The ocean is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the sable. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, expired if not renewed by fresh work, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Reaching the signal of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
